payloads.name: XPSemu Helper
payloads.description: Required helper payload for the original Xbox emulator XPSemu. Install XPSemu separately from the PS5 Library catalog, then load this helper ELF using kstuff before starting the emulator. Does not contain a BIOS or games.
payloads.author: ZiZc3

payloads.name: Ruffle Flash PS5 Helper
payloads.description: Required helper payload for Ruffle Flash PS5. Install the Ruffle app separately from the PS5 Library catalog, then load this helper ELF with kstuff before starting the app. Flash games are not included.
payloads.author: ZiZc3

payloads.name: PS5SX3 Helper (No Data Mount)
payloads.description: No-data-mount helper ELF reported working with a PS5SX3/RPCS3 setup. This is the original PS5SX2 helper published by Swordpdf, not an independently released PS5SX3 helper. It requires a compatible ShadowMount+ version to mount /data first; load ShadowMount+ before this helper. Do not load both PS5SX helper variants in one session. Does not include PS5SX3, BIOS, firmware or games.
payloads.author: Swordpdf

payloads.name: PS5SX2 Helper (Standard)
payloads.description: Official recommended PS5SX2 / PCSX2 helper enabling /data access and PS2 disc tiles. Load kstuff and ShadowMount+ first, then only this helper. Alternatively use the no-data-mount variant already in this feed with ShadowMount+ 1.7-beta5fix1 or newer. Never load both helper variants in one session. BIOS and games are not included.
payloads.author: Swordpdf
